milestone: M6 — GS2-06.7 workflow consolidation and change-impact selection

findings.summary: The accepted upstream change validates a fixed qualification corpus but does not implement the roadmap-required workflow consolidation or a change-impact selector that can classify arbitrary changed subjects and non-file inputs.
evidence: Verification: `git -C /home/developer/projects/FS.GG.Coordination diff --name-only ff65faa6697ea5835de72c1e6fa1b53af0a883e3..3277a7a581f9b75001a851e0b614de3c1eadf812` lists qualification-contract source/signature, validator scripts, retained evidence, tests, and SDD work/readiness artifacts, but no `.github/workflows`, composite action, reusable job, production selector, Core, GitHub adapter, CLI, or host implementation path; this conflicts with `docs/github-substrate-v2-roadmap.md` GS2-06.7, which requires consolidating reusable work and selecting the smallest sound job set.

Verification: `src/FS.GG.Coordination.Qualification.Contracts/GitHubWorkflowSelectionQualification.fs` at protected main 57305e540267f3f4696ba5a6cdfc84361de577d3 defines `expectedImpactBindings` as eleven exact fixture tuples; `compile` compares caller-supplied `ChangedSubjects`, `NonFileInputs`, and `Roots` to those tuples, checks caller-supplied `ExpectedClosure`, and returns only counts, fleet state, missed obligations, and a seal. The public signature exposes no operation that accepts a new changed-subject/non-file-input set and returns selected obligations or child outcomes.

Verification: Coordination issue https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination/issues/262 and its retained `work/262-workflow-selection/spec.md` FR-002 say the selector MUST compile a versioned dependency graph over changed subjects and non-file inputs into the smallest sound closure; PR https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination/pull/263 merged the fixed-corpus validator as 3277a7a581f9b75001a851e0b614de3c1eadf812 without such an input-to-selection API. The exact Q3 and Q7 scripts pass only after the Release contract assembly is built, printing 23 and 12 controls with seal 43836b63dc7c0324331a270f462ace5b73c6427ff573d80e152ad4d58e3f18ab; those green controls validate the fixed corpus and do not close the missing implementation surface.
resolution_evidence: Verification: unverified; repair requires a new independently reviewed Coordination exact head that implements the roadmap/spec input-to-selection behavior and workflow consolidation, adds positive and negative tests over previously unseen changed-subject/non-file-input combinations, and supersedes or amends the current accepted receipt before this projection can be confirmed.

findings.summary: The Q7 evidence does not prove measured per-repository baselines or accepted targets; it seals identical unexplained constants for every repository and tests only arithmetic ordering.
evidence: Verification: `evidence/github-substrate-v2/gs2-06-7/corpus.json` at Coordination protected main 57305e540267f3f4696ba5a6cdfc84361de577d3 contains ten repository rows, but every baseline is exactly workflowFanOut=4, jobFanOut=12, billedMinutes=120, queueTimeSeconds=300, p50Seconds=1200, p95Seconds=2400, every target is 3/9/90/240/1000/2100, and every selected value is 2/7/70/180/900/1800. The rows carry no observation window, run IDs, sample counts, source URLs, timestamps, collector identity, or acceptance authority.

Verification: `rg -n 'baseline|measured' work/262-workflow-selection evidence/github-substrate-v2/gs2-06-7 readiness/262-workflow-selection --glob '!*.trx'` finds the requirement/plan language and the literal corpus rows but no measurement provenance. `GitHubWorkflowSelectionQualification.compile` checks only that metrics are positive, targets are no worse than baselines, and selected values are no worse than targets; the 12 Q7 controls mutate row presence or numeric inequalities and never establish that any value was observed or accepted.

Verification: `docs/github-substrate-v2-roadmap.md` GS2-06.7 requires per-repository baselines and accepted targets for workflow/job fan-out, billed minutes, queue time, and p50/p95 completion time before cutover; the identical provenance-free literals therefore do not satisfy the roadmap evidence requirement even though `dotnet fsi eng/validate-github-workflow-selection-supply-chain.fsx -- .` prints a passing 12-control result.
resolution_evidence: Verification: unverified; repair requires traceable repository-specific measurements and target acceptance evidence, schema/compiler bindings that reject missing or stale provenance, independent controls for fabricated/cross-repository measurements, and a superseding independently reviewed Coordination acceptance chain.
